selected_rows.Description: Screen readers use headings for navigation
selected_rows.Don't: Skip heading levels or misuse for styling

selected_rows.Description: Content should make sense when read aloud
selected_rows.Do: Use semantic HTML and ARIA properly

selected_rows.Description: Autoplaying media consumes data and creates motion barriers
selected_rows.Do: Prefer click-to-play; provide pause and captions; stop off-screen and honor reduced motion
selected_rows.Don't: Auto-play high-resolution loops without pause or captions

selected_rows.Do: Provide previous next and play/pause; stop on focus or hover and when reduced motion is requested
selected_rows.Don't: Auto-advance slides without a stop control

selected_rows.Description: An error summary for failed validation complements inline field errors and must be easy to find by keyboard and screen reader users
selected_rows.Do: Place it at the top of the form; move focus to its heading or container after failed submit; link each item to its invalid field; retain inline errors
selected_rows.Don't: Replace inline errors with a visual-only summary or move focus on every blur
selected_rows.Code Example Good:
There is a problem

Enter an email address
selected_rows.Code Example Bad: Toast only with no field links or focus target

selected_rows.Description: Async badge and count changes should announce a meaningful contextual status without moving focus
selected_rows.Do: Use one appropriate atomic status message such as 3 items in cart
selected_rows.Don't: Announce a bare number or make every badge a competing live region
